_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the licence gate (licenses/policy.json). Owner decision 2026-11-22.
An entry allows ONE copyleft dependency that policy.json marks 'exceptable': an unmodified weak-copyleft library (MPL, LGPL, EPL, CDDL)
or an unmodified GPL program. It needs a `condition`: 'unmodified-not-linked' (weak copyleft, used unmodified, not linked into our code)
or 'separate-program' (runs as its own process; the only condition a GPL accepts). The gate checks the condition and still requires an
An exception can NEVER waive an UNKNOWN or missing licence: resolve it first to an SPDX id through an alias in policy.json (a reviewed
mapping), then the normal rules apply. AGPL, EUPL and source-available licences (BUSL/BSL, SSPL, Elastic, Commons Clause, CC-BY-NC/SA)
Every entry needs: ecosystem (npm | python | component), name, version ('*' or exact), condition, reason, reviewedBy and date (YYYY-MM-DD).
An entry that no longer matches any dependency is reported, so this file cannot rot silently.

exceptions.name: git (backup-tools, git-daemon and git-http images)
exceptions.reason: Unmodified Alpine git package, a separate program the chart runs as its own process (git bundle/fsck, git daemon, git-http-backend); never linked into our code. Source offer: licenses/source-offer.md.
